cinematic_dialogue:2:1720808003:.text: What did you mean just now?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1720808003:.male: What did you mean just now?
cinematic_dialogue:2:1720808003:.female: What did you mean just now?

say:4:1720809001:0.text: Two premium ales. One was ordered in advance by Valen for you.
say:4:1720809001:0.source_cn: 两杯精制麦酿，一杯是维伦提前为阁下点的。
say:4:1720809001:0.male: Two premium ales. One was ordered in advance by Valen for you.
say:4:1720809001:0.female: Two premium ales. One was ordered in advance by Valen for you.

say:5:1720809002:0.text: The other? Consider it a small thank you from the tavern to a certain knight who stepped in to help.
say:5:1720809002:0.source_cn: 另一杯么，就算是小店为某位见义勇为的骑士送上的谢礼了。

choice_prompt:6:1720809002.text: The other? Consider it a small thank you from the tavern to a certain knight who stepped in to help.
choice_prompt:6:1720809002.source_cn: 另一杯么，就算是小店为某位见义勇为的骑士送上的谢礼了。

say:7:1720809003:0.text: Oh? Valen, if I remember correctly, a knight shouldn't hide things from the person he swore loyalty to.
say:7:1720809003:0.source_cn: 哦？维伦，我记得骑士可不能对自己愿意效忠的人有所隐瞒。
say:7:1720809003:0.male: Oh? Valen, if I remember correctly, a knight shouldn't hide things from the person he swore loyalty to.
say:7:1720809003:0.female: Oh? Valen, if I remember correctly, a knight shouldn't hide things from the person he swore loyalty to.

say:8:1720809004:0.text: Shall I do the honors and tell the story for you—
say:8:1720809004:0.source_cn: 需不需要我代劳，帮你讲讲——

say:10:1720809006:0.text: Just kidding. You love joking around so much, don't you? I figured I'd return the favor for once.
say:10:1720809006:0.source_cn: 开个玩笑。谁叫你那么喜欢开玩笑呢？偶尔也得让我回敬一二吧。

say:11:1720809007:0.source_cn: 麦酿上齐了，二位请慢用。

say:12:1720809008:0.text: The tavern owner turns and leaves, cutting the conversation short. But your curiosity gets the better of you.
say:12:1720809008:0.source_cn: 老板转身离去，话题戛然而止。你的好奇心却如同从杯沿溢出...
say:12:1720809008:0.male: The tavern owner turns and leaves, cutting the conversation short. But your curiosity gets the better of you.
say:12:1720809008:0.female: The tavern owner turns and leaves, cutting the conversation short. But your curiosity gets the better of you.

choice_prompt:13:1720809008.text: The tavern owner turns and leaves, cutting the conversation short. But your curiosity gets the better of you.
choice_prompt:13:1720809008.source_cn: 老板转身离去，话题戛然而止。你的好奇心却如同从杯沿溢出的浮沫，一发不可收拾。
choice_prompt:13:1720809008.male: The tavern owner turns and leaves, cutting the conversation short. But your curiosity gets the better of you.
choice_prompt:13:1720809008.female: The tavern owner turns and leaves, cutting the conversation short. But your curiosity gets the better of you.

say:15:1720809012:0.text: (Sigh) There's no resisting a mage's curiosity.
say:15:1720809012:0.source_cn: 唉，真拿大魔法师的好奇心没办法啊。
say:15:1720809012:0.male: (Sigh) There's no resisting a mage's curiosity.
say:15:1720809012:0.female: (Sigh) There's no resisting a mage's curiosity.

say:16:1720809013:0.text: Of course I could tell you... But where's the fun in simply saying it out loud?
say:16:1720809013:0.source_cn: 告诉你当然可以，不过……直接说出来多没趣啊。
say:16:1720809013:0.male: Of course I could tell you... But where's the fun in simply saying it out loud?
say:16:1720809013:0.female: Of course I could tell you... But where's the fun in simply saying it out loud?

say:17:1720809014:0.text: How about coming with me to visit the Twilight Pavilion?
say:17:1720809014:0.source_cn: 不如跟我一起去趟隐士那里，怎么样？
say:17:1720809014:0.male: How about coming with me to visit the Twilight Pavilion?
say:17:1720809014:0.female: How about coming with me to visit the Twilight Pavilion?

say:18:1720809015:0.text: As they say, "Every piece of information has its price." My past should count as information too, right?
say:18:1720809015:0.source_cn: 正所谓“一切情报都有对应的价值”——我的过去，好歹应该...
say:18:1720809015:0.male: As they say, "Every piece of information has its price." My past should count as information too, right?
say:18:1720809015:0.female: As they say, "Every piece of information has its price." My past should count as information too, right?

choice_prompt:19:1720809015.text: As they say, "Every piece of information has its price." My past should count as information too, right?
choice_prompt:19:1720809015.source_cn: 正所谓“一切情报都有对应的价值”——我的过去，好歹应该也算是条情报吧？
choice_prompt:19:1720809015.male: As they say, "Every piece of information has its price." My past should count as information too, right?
choice_prompt:19:1720809015.female: As they say, "Every piece of information has its price." My past should count as information too, right?

say:21:1720809018:0.text: Information loses value over time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's head out now!
say:21:1720809018:0.male: Information loses value over time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's head out now!
say:21:1720809018:0.female: Information loses value over time, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Let's head out now!

choice:19:0:1.text: You'd better give me a discount.
choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 那你可要给我个优惠价
choice:19:0:1.male: You'd better give me a discount.
choice:19:0:1.female: You'd better give me a discount.

say:23:1720809017:0.text: Yep! When you see him, put in a good word for me, will you?
say:23:1720809017:0.source_cn: 是啊，等见到了他，你可要好好替我美言几句。
say:23:1720809017:0.male: Yep! When you see him, put in a good word for me, will you?
say:23:1720809017:0.female: Yep! When you see him, put in a good word for me, will you?

choice:19:1:2.text: Are you trying to increase business for Eryndor?
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 你这是要帮埃德加拉笔生意？
choice:19:1:2.male: Are you trying to increase business for Eryndor?
choice:19:1:2.female: Are you trying to increase business for Eryndor?

say:25:1720809009:0.text: ... What kind of look is that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:25:1720809009:0.male: ... What kind of look is that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:25:1720809009:0.female: ... What kind of look is that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:26:1720809010:0.text: Last time someone from the Solitaries looked at me like that, they dug up every piece of intel I'd just uncovered.
say:26:1720809010:0.source_cn: 上次有隐士的人这么看着我，下一秒就把我刚查到的秘密情报...
say:26:1720809010:0.male: Last time someone from the Solitaries looked at me like that, they dug up every piece of intel I'd just uncovered.
say:26:1720809010:0.female: Last time someone from the Solitaries looked at me like that, they dug up every piece of intel I'd just uncovered.

say:27:1720809011:0.text: Alright, alright, I get it. You want to know about my past, right?
say:27:1720809011:0.source_cn: 好了好了，我知道。你想问我的过去，是不是？
say:27:1720809011:0.male: Alright, alright, I get it. You want to know about my past, right?
say:27:1720809011:0.female: Alright, alright, I get it. You want to know about my past, right?

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你刚刚说到维伦的“以前”……

choice:6:1:2.text: I realized I don't know that much about him.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我还完全不了解维伦的过去呢
choice:6:1:2.male: I realized I don't know that much about him.
choice:6:1:2.female: I realized I don't know that much about him.
